blocks.title: Short-hand if-else
blocks.text: Python if-else ko ek line mein likhne deti hai: action_if_true if condition else action_if_false.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
temperature = 15
print("It's a hot day") if temperature > 30 else print("It's not a hot day")
Yeh pichhli misal wala hi kaam mukhtasar shakal mein karta hai: temperature 30 se zyada ho to "It's a hot day", warna "It's not a hot day" print karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Short-hand if-else aam if-else se kaise mukhtalif hai (short question 4)?
blocks.explanation: Yeh poora intikhab ek line mein rakhta aur har soorat ke liye ek qeemat ya amal deta hai, jo saade intikhab ke liye munasib hai; aam if-else alag indent wale blocks istemal karta aur har shaakh mein kai statements rakh sakta hai.

items: Short hand: ek line mein x if condition else y; do shaakhon wale if-else jaisa nateeja.
